Product Features

  • Plenty of storage space: panel with 4 hooks for optimal comfort, practical layout with doors, drawers and shelves
  • [Sturdy and Durable]- This coat set is made of high-quality chipboard material, ensuring excellent stability and durability. It can carry 5-150kg and is not so easy to tip over.
  • Modern, easy-care combination consisting of 1 x bench, 1 x wardrobe panel, 1 x shoe cabinet.
  • Dimensions (assembled W x H x D): (assembled W x H x D): Combination: 140 x 180 x 30.5cm / Shoe cabinet: 80 x 104 x 30.5 cm / Wardrobe panel: 60 x 126.7 x 17 cm. /Shoe bench: 60 x 53.5 x 32 cm
  • This product is packed in two boxes. Please make sure you receive all packages before assembly to avoid missing parts.
  • Wardrobe Organizer – The coat rack organizer with hook offers great flexibility and adaptability. You can easily organize and display hats, bags, tools or decorative items according to your wishes.
  • Storage Bench – This entryway organizer has a large bench where you can sit and change your shoes. In addition, shelves and open compartments under the bench provide ample storage space for various items.
  • High-quality wood coat rack – Made with high-quality hardware and sturdy chipboard, it features a sturdy construction that can withstand daily use.
  • Versatile 3-in-1 design – The all-in-one board stand puts an end to the chaos in the entrance area! Consisting of a bench, a closet and four coat hooks, this elegant unit offers a complete solution for a tidy and organized entryway.
  • Safe and Durable Use – Equipped with important safety precautions such as an anti-tilt device, our wooden stand provides greater security for your home and family.
